task_description: Implement 6 expert panel recommendations: (1) String model in main simulation, (2) Net-billing deposit, (3) Bypass diode threshold to 15%, (4) Inverter efficiency curve, (5) Bifacial panels, (6) Seller margin on energy sale price. Features are ordered so foundational changes come first.

verification.summary: All 386 tests pass (originally 323). New tests cover inverter efficiency curve, bifacial gain, string model division, net-billing deposit, and seller margin. Tests verify actual computation logic with meaningful assertions.
